# Umbix Dynamics

Umbix Dynamics is an edtech company specializing in adaptive tutoring solutions tailored for K-12 public school systems. Its flagship product, MasteryMap, delivers personalized learning pathways that dynamically adjust to each student’s progress, ensuring mastery of core subjects while providing teachers and administrators with real-time dashboards to monitor individual and cohort performance.

### Product Overview
MasteryMap leverages a combination of machine learning algorithms and pedagogical best practices to assess student mastery continuously. It supports core subjects including math, science, and literacy, adapting content difficulty and recommending targeted interventions. The platform’s teacher dashboard offers granular insights into student progress, enabling data-driven instructional decisions. District procurement teams benefit from centralized management tools for license allocation, compliance tracking, and outcome reporting.

### Customers and Traction
Currently deployed in 120 school districts across three states, Umbix Dynamics serves approximately 45,000 active student users. Key customers include the Lakeside Unified and Midland County School District, who report improved standardized test results and increased student engagement after one academic year of implementation. The company has secured $12 million in Series A funding led by the Pine Valley Education Fund, supporting ongoing product development and scaling efforts.

### Team
The founding team comprises CEO Dr. Xanrel Morales, a former district curriculum director; CTO Rajiv Dorow, an AI specialist; and COO Simone Lee, with experience in K-12 edtech sales and operations.

### Competitors
Main competitors include LearnSphere, QuestEd, and TutorWave. Umbix differentiates itself with deeper mastery tracking granularity and district-focused procurement features.

### Open Risks
- Dependence on district budget cycles may slow adoption.
- Potential challenges integrating with legacy SIS platforms.
- Ongoing need to demonstrate measurable academic impact to justify renewals.
